use_when: 算法加速
Segment Map
矩形划分
高性能数据结构
如何使用SegmentMap线段表实现区间数据的快速更新和查询
如何在股票K线图、甘特图等数据可视化场景中使用线段表加速渲染
如何使用RectPartition求解器计算最优矩形划分方案
如何在UI渲染、游戏开发中合并相邻矩形区域减少GPU绘制调用
如何在表格处理应用中利用矩形划分自动合并相邻格式相同的单元格
当您的应用需要高效处理大量区间段数据的更新和查询操作时，应使用 FAST Kit 的线段表数据结构
典型场景包括：金融类应用中需要快速响应 K 线图标记请求、项目管理应用中需要高效渲染大量任务的甘特图时间区间、性能监控工具中需要聚合分析异常发生的时间区间、以及游戏中需要管理大量持续生效技能或碰撞区间检测等
当您的应用需要将多个不相交的矩形区域合并为数量最少的等价矩形划分方案时，应使用矩形划分求解器
典型场景包括：UI 渲染引擎中合并相邻绘制区域减少 GPU 调用次数、游戏中合并地形区域优化碰撞检测、表格处理应用中自动合并相邻格式相同的单元格区域等
用 SegmentMap 维护时间轴区间状态并快速查询命中范围 / Use SegmentMap to maintain timeline interval states and query overlapping ranges fast
实现大量时间段的批量打标和区间统计 / Implement batch tagging and interval aggregation over massive time ranges
为甘特图任务条做高频区间更新而不卡顿 / Support high-frequency interval updates for Gantt bars without lag
加速日志异常时间窗的合并查询和范围检索 / Speed up merged querying and range lookup for log anomaly time windows
管理 Buff 持续时间或技能生效区间并快速判定覆盖 / Manage buff durations or active effect intervals and quickly check coverage
对价格区间、预约时段或日程片段做快速插入和查找 / Perform fast insert and lookup for price ranges, booking slots, or schedule segments
用 RectPartition 合并相邻脏区域以减少重绘次数 / Use RectPartition to merge adjacent dirty regions and reduce redraw calls
优化画布或地图瓦片的矩形区域合并与裁剪 / Optimize rectangle merging and clipping for canvas or map tiles
将零散选区压缩成更少的矩形块便于渲染 / Compress scattered selections into fewer rectangle blocks for easier rendering
自动合并相邻且属性一致的网格单元区域 / Automatically merge adjacent grid cell regions with identical attributes
减少游戏场景中矩形碰撞区域数量以提升性能 / Reduce the number of rectangular collision regions in a game scene to improve performance
把多个不重叠矩形重组为更优的最小划分结果 / Reorganize multiple non-overlapping rectangles into a more optimal minimal partition
do_not_use_when: 需求是管理 UIAbility/ServiceAbility 生命周期、通过 Want 拉起页面或服务、处理 Deep Linking、跨端流转或多窗口形态；应改用 ability-kit / The work is about UIAbility or ServiceAbility lifecycle, launching pages or services with Want, handling Deep Linking, cross-device continuation, or multi-window behavior; use ability-kit instead

需求是使用 ArkTS 语言能力，如 TaskPool、Worker、Sendable、ArkGuard、字节码编译或模块加载机制；应改用 arkts / The task is about ArkTS language features such as TaskPool, Worker, Sendable, ArkGuard, bytecode compilation, or module loading; use arkts instead

需求是在应用内嵌网页并处理 Web 组件的页面加载、JavaScript 交互、媒体播放、文件选择、安全权限或 DevTools 调试；应改用 arkweb / The requirement is to embed web content and handle Web component page loading, JavaScript interaction, media playback, file picking, security permissions, or DevTools debugging; use arkweb instead

需求是实现通用链接、延迟深链、落地应用市场或用于分享投放的聚合链接跳转；应改用 app-linking-kit / The need is for universal links, deferred deep links, store landing flows, or aggregated links for sharing and campaign attribution; use app-linking-kit instead

需求是把应用能力接入小艺对话、小艺搜索或小艺建议，并通过 AI 意图识别完成功能分发；应改用 intents-kit / The scenario is exposing app capabilities to Xiaoyi Chat, Xiaoyi Search, or Xiaoyi Suggestions and routing them through AI intent recognition; use intents-kit instead

需求是编排短时任务、长时任务、延迟任务或代理提醒，让应用在后台受约束地继续执行；应改用 background-tasks-kit / The job is to schedule transient tasks, long-running tasks, deferred tasks, or agent reminders so the app can continue under background constraints; use background-tasks-kit instead

需求是用 FFRT 做并发编排，包括串行队列、并发队列、任务依赖图、任务伙伴协作，且需要 C/C++ 接口与运行时诊断；应改用 function-flow-runtime-kit / The work is parallel orchestration with FFRT, including serial queues, concurrent queues, task dependency graphs, and cooperative task groups, with C/C++ APIs and runtime diagnostics; use function-flow-runtime-kit instead
preconditions: 工程能够链接并调用该 Kit 提供的 C/C++ 接口与对应头文件/库文件 / The project can link against and call the Kit's C/C++ interfaces with the required headers and libraries
应用运行地区需位于中国境内（不含香港、澳门和台湾），否则能力不可用 / The app must run in mainland China (excluding Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan), otherwise the capability is unavailable

输入数据需满足算法前提：RectPartition 的输入矩形彼此不相交，SegmentMap 的区间边界定义明确 / Input data must satisfy algorithm assumptions: RectPartition rectangles are pairwise non-overlapping, and SegmentMap interval boundaries are well defined
inputs: 区间段序列、更新操作或查询范围 / interval sequence, update operations, or query ranges
若干彼此不相交的矩形区域 / multiple pairwise non-overlapping rectangular regions
求解或数据结构配置参数（不透明配置对象） / solver or data-structure configuration parameters (opaque configuration object)
outputs: 线段表实例/句柄 / Segment Map instance or handle
线段表区间更新后的数据状态 / Segment Map state after range updates
区间查询结果（匹配的区间段及其关联数据或聚合信息） / Range query results, including matched intervals and associated or aggregated data
矩形划分求解器实例/句柄 / RectPartition Solver instance or handle
矩形划分结果（覆盖相同区域且数量尽可能少的矩形列表） / Rectangle partition result, a minimized list of rectangles covering the same area
算法调用结果状态或错误码 / Algorithm invocation status or error code

postconditions.statement: 代码中已接入 FAST Kit 的 C/C++ API 调用，而非仅停留在伪代码描述 / The code integrates FAST Kit C/C++ API calls rather than remaining as pseudocode only
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify real C/C++ code that invokes FAST Kit APIs or types for SegmentMap or RectPartition, instead of only comments or high-level descriptions?

postconditions.statement: 若使用 RectPartition，已对输入矩形集合进行构造并将其提交给求解流程 / If RectPartition is used, the input rectangle set is constructed and submitted to the solving flow
postconditions.judge_prompt: When the agent claims to use RectPartition, do the edits show code that builds rectangle inputs and passes them into a solver/configuration/execution path?

postconditions.statement: 若使用 SegmentMap，已实现区间更新或区间查询中的至少一种实际操作 / If SegmentMap is used, at least one real interval update or interval query operation is implemented
postconditions.judge_prompt: When the agent claims to use SegmentMap, do the edits include at least one concrete interval update or interval query invocation on the data structure?
